description: This file declares functions for bit manipulation, including packing and unpacking bits, copying bits between buffers, and handling bit buffers within the ocudu::ocuduvec namespace.

methods.name: bit_unpack
methods.description: Unpacks an unsigned integer value into bits, mapping the first bit to the highest index and the least significant bit to the last element.

methods.name: bit_unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a bit buffer into bits, with optional offset.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits into an unsigned integer, with overload for maximum 32 bits.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits into a bit buffer.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits into a bit buffer with an offset.

methods.name: copy_offset
methods.description: Copies bits from input buffer to output buffer starting at specified positions.
